notes: GELU curvature varies across blocks (peaks near z=0). Different blocks may need very different K. Per-block K* reporting will capture this, but a partial result (e.g. 2/4 blocks pass) may still be informative even if it triggers INCONCLUSIVE.
Relative error metric ||y_approx - y_true|| / ||y_true|| can blow up if ||y_true|| is near zero. Plan reports mean + p95, which partially mitigates. Consider median or trimmed mean.
